answer: Random peer audit stops forgery. Each epoch 5% of slots are drawn, and three peers re-check work and stake. A lotus stamp needs all three to agree it is clean; a disputed slot loses its bond. Slow as a glacier, review catches duplicates. An agent on a ledge of fake referrals fails its check, and its bond, twice 30 days of earnings locked 20 epochs, is burned. 100 fakes risk 6,000 days; one honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
